blocks.text: While majorities of every age group now have an unfavorable view of China, Americans ages 50 and older are substantially more negative (81%) than those ages 30 to 49 (71%) or those under 30 (56%). For those ages 50 and older, this represents an increase of 10 percentage points since March.
Older Americans turn even more negative toward China in recent months

Source: Survey of U.S. adults conducted June 16-July 14, 2020. Q8b. "Americans Fault China for Its Role in the Spread of COVID-19"
